name: @stapel/tokens-antd
description: Token bridge (§68 neutral colour-role dictionary; frontend-guidelines §2.4, §38 T3): projects @stapel/tokens' roles (surface, brand, text-muted, success-bg, ...) onto an Ant Design ConfigProvider theme. `toAntdTheme(mode)` -> theme.token; `toAntdThemeConfig(mode)` -> the full ThemeConfig (algorithm + token). Pure functions reading the same `colors` object as @stapel/tokens-mui, so they cannot diverge. The root export is not components; the `/skin` subpath is the shared skin substrate every antd default skin inherits -- SkinTheme + useThemeMode (self-theming from the live data-theme, 44px phone controls), SkinDialog + SkinConfirm (a dialog is a bottom sheet on a phone), ErrorAlert / EmptyState / LoadBoundary / LoadList (the designed state arms), GatedControl / GatedButton (a blocked control's reason as visible text).

size-limit.name: root -- the pure token bridge (no components, no React)
skin subpath -- the shared skin substrate (theme, dialog, confirm, states, gate)
